question: In 2020, Poulomi Ghatak announced her retirement from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**table tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Table Tennis star, Poulomi Ghatak **had announced retirement in 2020.
 
• She competed for India in the 2006 Commonwealth Games and the Commonwealth Championships from 2000 to 2008.
 
• When **she was16, she competed in her first Olympic Games in Sydney**.
 
• Poulomi has the following accomplishments and medals:
 
 
• In 2006, she won the gold medal in Women’s doubles at the South Asian Federation (SAF) Games.
 
• She won bronze at the Commonwealth Championships in 2007.
 
• She won silver at the Commonwealth Games in 2010.
